product_facts: AEM Sites as a Cloud Service is built on Adobe's Core Components and page templates, with code deployed through Cloud Manager and pages edited visually in the Universal Editor.
AEM Sites is where the site is built, on Adobe's Core Components and page templates, and where your authors edit its pages.
We would implement AEM Sites as a Cloud Service. Code is deployed through Cloud Manager, Adobe's one route for it, so every release passes the same code quality checks.
We would start with discovery: a review of your current site's content, templates and integrations, a named team with agreed roles, and the measures of success.

How your existing content moves depends on where it sits today. From an existing AEM instance, Adobe's Content Transfer Tool moves it across. From another CMS, we would export the content, map it to the new templates and load it into AEM, agreeing the mapping and tooling with you in discovery.

For go-live we would plan a content freeze for the final content top-up, check the migrated content with you, test in the stage environment, which has the same sizing as production, and run user acceptance testing on a test subdomain before the DNS cutover, with redirects for retired URLs and rollback criteria agreed beforehand.

AEM Sites is where the site is built, on Adobe's Core Components and page templates, and where your authors edit its pages.
We would implement AEM Sites as a Cloud Service. Code is deployed through Cloud Manager, Adobe's one route for it, so every release passes the same code quality checks.
We would start with discovery: a review of your current site's content, templates and integrations, a named team with agreed roles, and the measures of success.

How your existing content moves depends on where it sits today. From an existing AEM instance, Adobe's Content Transfer Tool moves it across. From another CMS, we would export the content, map it to the new templates and load it into AEM, agreeing the mapping and tooling with you in discovery.

For go-live we would plan a content freeze for the final content top-up, check the migrated content with you, test in the stage environment, which has the same sizing as production, and run user acceptance testing on a test subdomain before the DNS cutover, with redirects for retired URLs and rollback criteria agreed beforehand.

product_facts: Journey Optimizer is Adobe's application for creating and delivering connected, personalized customer experiences across your channels. It is built on Adobe Experience Platform and its real-time customer profile, and runs both real-time journeys and scheduled campaigns.
Journey Optimizer orchestrates the journeys and campaigns and delivers the messages across channels.

We would set Journey Optimizer up in the order Adobe documents: the environment first, with a development sandbox for building and testing and a production sandbox for sending, each with its own channel configurations. Journeys are tested with test profiles before activation.

A journey automates a real-time, multi-step sequence of interactions; a campaign sends a scheduled or API-triggered message to an audience. Messages are delivered through channels like email, mobile messages, push notifications and direct mail.
Journey Optimizer tracks customer engagement and campaign performance with reports, and its reporting is integrated with Customer Journey Analytics for a clearer view of performance metrics.

When messages are sent from journeys or campaigns, your customers must always be able to unsubscribe; once they do, their profiles are automatically removed from the audience of future marketing messages. Access labels control which users can reach specific journeys, campaigns and channel configurations.

product_facts: Journey Optimizer B2B Edition orchestrates person and account journeys for marketing-qualified buying groups. Account journeys move accounts through the journey, not people, and the product is built on Adobe Experience Platform, including Real-Time CDP B2B.
Journey Optimizer B2B Edition runs the account journeys and the buying groups.

A buying group is the subset of people in an account who make the purchase decision. An account journey splits its paths on account, people or buying group criteria, and on each path actions send communications or wait for an event to occur.

Experience Platform is the primary data store for accounts, people and opportunities, and audiences are built with Real-Time CDP account segmentation. A dedicated Marketo Engage instance provides email delivery, so we would configure email tracking and deliverability there and in the B2B Edition app.

Your existing Marketo Engage instances can be connected as well: journey actions coordinate the account-based journeys with lead-based campaigns in Marketo Engage, such as adding people to a list or a request campaign.
Its Intelligent Dashboard provides a comprehensive view of buying group and account metrics, to monitor your marketing efforts.

services.name: Implement Brand Concierge
services.scope: Set up the Brand Concierge experience for the agreed banking or insurance products: connect and curate the approved content sources, design the conversations and guardrails for the agreed questions, configure the brand voice and the required disclosures, set up the handoff (live chat, meeting booking or both) routed to one Client-designated team, build, with the Client's reviewers, the golden-answer test set (including the priority discovery questions from the Brand Visibility program) and the refusal and escalation scenarios, complete Adobe's pre-go-live checks, and launch on the agreed pages in stages.

source.title: Experience League: Brand Concierge pre-go-live checklist and rollout plan

services.template_deliverable: A live Brand Concierge experience on the agreed pages; the source, guardrail and disclosure configuration; the golden-answer test set and results; the refusal and escalation scenarios; the completed pre-go-live checklist; and the launch and rollout record.
services.template_acceptance: Client reviewers approve the sampled answers, disclosures and the handoff; the golden-answer set scores at or above the agreed level for correctness, helpfulness and brand fit, and the refusal and escalation scenarios pass; stakeholders sign off the pre-go-live checks; and the experience is live on the agreed pages, rolled out in the agreed stages.
services.template_assumptions:
The Client has licensed Brand Concierge and supplies the approved content, current product facts, reviewers and the handoff destination; compliance decisions stay with the Client.

The handoff is live chat or meeting booking through Adobe Marketo Qualifier (formerly Sales Qualifier), which needs the representatives added as users in the Adobe Admin Console and at least one representative with a connected calendar (for meeting booking) or set live chat availability (for live chat). A handoff to another chat or contact-center platform is not part of this service.

Live chat and meeting booking don't need Marketo Engage: round robin and direct-agent routing work without it, and it is needed only for custom routing rules, which pick a team by Marketo attributes, and for writing concierge activities to the Marketo person record. Live chat conversations are kept for 30 days, so the Client confirms its own record-keeping needs.

The baseline is the anonymous, public-information experience; profile-based answers are not assumed. Hours scale with the number of products, sources, journeys and test conversations.

These hours cover the partner's work around Adobe's setup: approved sources and reviewers, conversation and disclosure design, the handoff, the golden-answer and refusal tests and the staged rollout.
services.template_exclusions: New content, legal or compliance advice, a new chat or appointment platform, ongoing answer review (a separate service) and Coworker Skills.
services.template_basis: One Brand Concierge experience: approved content sources, conversation design for the agreed products, one handoff route, testing and launch on the agreed pages. Adobe's Brand Concierge FAQ puts a basic setup at about 3 to 5 days, an advanced implementation at about 2 to 4 weeks and go-live at about 6 to 9 weeks; these hours are a planning assumption for the work around that setup, not yet reconciled with Adobe's figures or an independent delivery estimate.
product_facts: Brand Concierge is Adobe's platform for conversational experiences on your website, mobile apps and other digital properties. Every conversation is grounded in your own content and guardrails.
Brand Concierge answers visitors' questions from the content you approve.

Brand Concierge answers only from the knowledge sources you configure (website pages, PDFs and product spreadsheets), not from general world knowledge. Website sources refresh on a schedule you set, so answers keep up with the pages you publish.

When a question falls outside those sources, the concierge is designed to say it does not have the information rather than generate an unsupported answer, and guardrails can exclude topics such as legal or compliance matters.

Brand Concierge is focused on anonymous visitors: it answers from the conversation and your knowledge sources, not from an individual customer's records. Questions about a customer's own account would go to your secure channels.

Before launch, it is tested against a golden set of real customer questions paired with ideal answers, including questions it should not answer; after launch, conversation transcripts are reviewed on a recurring basis.

services.name: Financial-services answer and source review
services.scope: Review up to 40 sampled Concierge conversations in four scheduled batches against Client-approved financial-product references. Flag potential mismatches involving rates, fees, eligibility, policy conditions, disclosures or handoffs, and route findings to named Client reviewers.

source.title: Experience League: Pre-go-live checklist, quality benchmarks and guardrails

services.template_deliverable: Sampling record, evidence-linked exception log, source-refresh requests and a consolidated report with Client decisions and action owners.
services.template_acceptance: The agreed sample is reviewed, findings trace back to source conversations and references, and Client reviewers receive the exceptions and proposed follow-up actions. Client reviewers retain compliance decisions.
services.template_assumptions: The Client provides appropriately authorized conversation access, current source material, review criteria and named reviewers. Sampling is agreed in advance. Coworker review Skills are optional; their setup is separately scoped if selected. Shared Brand Visibility performance reporting is reused, not repeated.
services.template_exclusions: Full-population monitoring, legal advice or compliance certification, automated financial advice, new data pipelines, Coworker Skill development, content remediation and live-chat operations.
services.template_basis: One monthly package: four review batches of up to 10 Concierge conversations each, one approved source set and one consolidated findings report.

source.title: Adobe Firefly help: Adobe Brand Intelligence overview

product_facts: Brand Intelligence is a continuously learning platform that helps your teams create and validate on-brand content. It learns from your assets, past reviews and team decisions, and is a headless platform exposed through APIs rather than a separate app.
Brand Intelligence checks whether content adheres to your brand standards before it goes live.

Brand Intelligence brings together your brand guidelines, design systems, creative assets, human feedback and approvals, and your brand profile is configured during onboarding. Because it is a headless platform exposed through APIs, we would then integrate it with your existing apps.

The Validate skill automatically checks whether content adheres to your brand standards before it goes live, across designs, images, documents and layouts. Each approval, edit or rejection of a suggestion feeds back into Brand Intelligence for continuous learning.
The Instruct to Assemble skill turns a campaign brief into on-brand content variants by selecting the best-fit creative elements and assembling them into production-ready outputs.

It integrates through APIs: your systems submit a batch of assets and receive structured pass/fail feedback per asset, authenticated with OAuth Server-to-Server credentials set up in the Adobe Developer Console.

product_facts: Brand Visibility measures how your brand appears in AI-generated answers, recommends content changes and tracks how that performance changes over time.
Brand Visibility measures how your brand appears in AI-generated answers.

Brand Visibility runs the prompts you choose on a recurring basis across the AI platforms it supports and records how your brand appears in each answer and how that changes over time. It measures the prompts you monitor: the questions people put to AI assistants themselves are not disclosed by the platforms.
Adobe's Brand Presence page lists ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini and Perplexity as supported.

Its AI Visibility view opens the full AI answer behind a prompt: the response text, whether your brand was mentioned, which other brands were mentioned, whether your site was cited and the source URLs behind the answer.

The dashboards report the percentage of prompts where your brand is mentioned, how often your website is used as a source, share of voice and sentiment, and compare you with the other brands you choose to track in each market.
